**lebop v0.0.6** — agent-first Linear control plane.

This release is the first public cut of the 0.0.6 train: machine-default AXI
output, progressive MCP, multi-workspace state isolation, densified agent
continuations, and a content size policy for large Linear bodies. Authenticate
with a Linear **personal API key** (`lin_api_…`) only — lebop is a tool *for*
coding agents, not a Linear OAuth app-agent host.

## Highlights

- **Machine default / AXI density.** CLI defaults to machine envelopes
  (`schema_version: 2`, TOON for uniform tables). No `--json` required for
  agent use. MCP tool text is compact JSON. Slim list projections, string
  assignee on default lists, densified `next[]` stubs on high-frequency and
  tertiary write paths (set/pull/push/archive/relation/plan/diff/link/
  attachment/bulk).
- **Publish handoff.** Ready reviews emit dual form: `next[]` string stubs
  **and** structured `next_call` `{ tool: "publish_linear_changes",
  arguments: { review_id, verify: true, workspace } }` for MCP hosts that
  invoke tools by name.
- **Progressive MCP.** Default profile **core (17 tools)**; `--profile full`
  exposes the full dual inventory (**104 tools**). Core membership is derived
  from surface tags.
- **Multi-workspace paths.** Cache/context under
  `~/.lebop/{cache,context}/<slug>/<repo-hash>/`. Unset multi-ws selection
  fails closed with `workspace_required` + available slugs.
- **Content size policy.** Large text on issue/document/project/initiative
  getters defaults to a **64 KiB** UTF-8 cap. Prefer `--content-file` /
  `content_file` (writes host FS) for large bodies; `--full-content` /
  `full_content` for full wire. Never rewrite description from a truncated get.
- **`--human` / `LEBOP_HUMAN`.** Maintainer/dev chalk presentation only
  (full bodies). Not an agent product path; not taught in the skill.
- **Workspace fetch modular layout.** Kind contexts live under
  `src/lib/workspace/` (mechanical hygiene; same public API).
- **Live gates.** Release runs compiled Linux **full surface** smoke and
  **discovery** smoke (`LEBOP_LIVE_BIN`), both sandbox-serialized; discovery
  reports are sanitized and `--validate-report` fail-closed.
- **Soft-delete naming (breaking).** Project/document/initiative (and status
  update) soft-deletes use clear names: CLI `project soft-delete` / MCP
  `soft_delete_project` (etc.). Old `delete_project` / `project delete` names
  are removed (hard cutover).
- **Agent skills.** Six isolated verticals (`lebop-cli*`, `lebop-mcp*`);
  content_file getters are not pure read-only (host FS write capability).

## Upgrade notes

- **Soft-delete hard cutover (breaking).** If you scripted CLI
  `project delete` / `document delete` / `initiative delete` /
  `project-update delete` / `initiative-update delete`, switch to
  **`soft-delete`** on those subjects. MCP `delete_project` /
  `delete_document` / `delete_initiative` / `delete_project_update` /
  `delete_initiative_update` are now **`soft_delete_*`**. **No aliases** —
  old names fail. Issue `archive` / hard `delete` for labels, milestones,
  comments, attachments, views, relations are unchanged.
- **Envelope:** consumers must accept `schema_version: 2` (was 1 in older
  notes for prior tags).
- **MCP:** default tool list is **core (17)** unless the host requests full
  (`--profile full`, **104** tools). Soft-delete tools are full-profile only.
- **CLI:** machine/TOON output is default; `--json` is an accepted alias
  (still TOON unless format override). `--human` / `LEBOP_HUMAN` is
  maintainer presentation only.
- **Paths:** multi-ws installs isolate cache/context by workspace slug.
  Unset multi-ws selection fails closed with `workspace_required`.
- **Content size:** large bodies default-capped; use `--content-file` /
  `content_file` or `--full-content` / `full_content`. `content_file`
  writes host FS (getters are not pure read-only while that param exists).
- **Skills:** prefer the **six** isolated verticals (`lebop-cli*`,
  `lebop-mcp*`) after `./bin/install-claude`; legacy flat skill names are
  migrated aside by the installer.
- Drop-in for most public verbs; re-read skill/spec for content size flags and
  `next_call` on publish ready.

## Agent-facing notes

- Prefer **CLI** when the host can shell out; MCP when it cannot
  (`lebop mcp`, default core profile).
- Follow **`next[]`** continuations; for ready publish reviews prefer
  **`next_call`** when the host can call tools by name.
- Envelopes use **`schema_version: 2`** (not 1).
- Large bodies: machine path is size-capped; use `--content-file` or
  `--full-content` before editing fat issues/docs. **`content_file` writes
  host FS** (getters are not pure read-only while that parameter exists).
- Destructive/overwrite tools need `confirm: true` / CLI `--yes`. Force on
  push/plan skips **all** freshness preflight (stale + missing + invalid).
- Multi-ws: select workspace (`--workspace` / `LEBOP_WORKSPACE` / auth default)
  or state paths fail with `workspace_required`.
- Authenticate with a Linear personal API key (`lin_api_…`).

## Live surface honesty (Option A)

Four agent-session **id-based** live steps (view/get/fetch) remain
**allowlisted fixture gaps** through **2026-09-30**: the sandbox has no
externally created AgentSessions, and lebop does not create sessions. List
and non-id paths still prove product. Non-allowlisted gaps fail release.

## Correctness and hygiene

- Full unit/integration suite green on the release train (re-stamp count on cut).
- Full surface live **308 pass / 4 Option A gaps / 0 fail** with validate-report
  (re-stamp on cut tree before tag recommended).
- Release builds compile four binaries:
  `lebop-{darwin,linux}-{x64,arm64}`.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/N0xMare/lebop/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

macOS / Linux, x64 / arm64. Verifies SHA256 against the `SHA256SUMS`
attached to this release. Pin this release with `LEBOP_VERSION=v0.0.6`.

```sh
lebop update --version v0.0.6
```
